phase_0.boundary_condition: Bitcoin consensus rules and Bech32 encoding specification

VINIT.justification: The void before Bech32 encoding — a 256-bit hash exists but has no surface representation, no network address, no spendable form

TANCH.justification: The Bech32 format boundary that contains the address — network topology, witness version, and checksum envelope that closes the system

AFWD.justification: ScriptPubKey as catalytic constraint — it lowers the verification barrier for a valid witness without being consumed, a forward morphism from locking to unlocking

AREV.justification: Signed directional polarity of the witness commitment — the reverse morphism from spending witness back to the fixed public key hash, chirality with memory depth n

CLINK.justification: Composition of 252 bits structured data with 30-bit checksum — sequential chaining of witness program, version, and error detection into a single surface string

IMSCRIB.justification: Consensus-critical threshold self-recognition — the address structure recognizes its own validity at the exact byte length where witness validation rules activate

FSPLIT.justification: Witness validation forks into two arms: valid witness satisfying scriptPubKey (T-arm) and invalid witness rejected by consensus (F-arm)

FFUSE.justification: Disjunctive partner selection rejoins the arms — any one valid signature from the authorized key set suffices, fusing valid/invalid into spendable/unspendable

EVALT.justification: Static immutable UTXO reference — the affirmative anchor where a valid witness touches constructive truth, high energetic barrier overcome

EVALF.justification: Fixed deterministic commitment with enforced chirality — the negative anchor where an invalid witness touches constructive falsity, cryptographic history depth n rejects forgery

ENGAGR.justification: 1:1 stoichiometric paradice — single public key hash to single locking script, both spendable and unspendable held simultaneously at the threshold boundary

IFIX.justification: Z₂-protected consensus fixation — 2-of-3 multisig policy permanently fixed at SegWit v0 threshold, cannot deform to single-key without crossing topological boundary

phase_2.fuse_result: Spendable UTXO (valid) or unspendable output (invalid) — conflicting arms rejoin to B at the disjunctive partner selection
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: Unencoded 256-bit hash before Bech32 representation — no address, no network identity, no spendable form
phase_3.true_description: Valid witness satisfying scriptPubKey — UTXO spendable, consensus accepts, transaction propagates
phase_3.false_description: Invalid witness rejected by consensus — UTXO unspendable, mempool rejects, cryptographic commitment holds
phase_3.both_description: Paradice at threshold — 1:1 stoichiometry holds spendable and unspendable simultaneously; 2-of-3 multisig keeps both states live until threshold crossed
